user: I was in hospital after that car accident in March. They admitted me at 9:40pm on 14 March and I was discharged at 8:20am on 18 March. How much hospital cash should Meridian pay me?
answer:
DearPolicy

For Simon, Meridian’s Hospital daily allowance is S$120 per day for an adult, up to 60 days per policy year, and its wording counts each complete 24-hour period plus a further day for a remaining period of at least 12 hours (page 1; page 2).

Based on the admission and discharge times you gave, the indicative estimate is S$360 for three payable days; this is not a confirmed payout, assuming at least 3 of the 60 days are still available this policy year.

The policy is accident-only, and the hospital cash benefit is payable only when the confinement results solely and directly from an Accident and begins within 90 days of it (page 2).

SOURCES
Indicative estimates are worked out from your documents and what you have told me; they are not a payout, and the insurer decides what it pays.

user: Did that endorsement letter change anything? How much is the daily hospital allowance for the kids now?
answer:
DearPolicy

Yes—the endorsement raised the SafeStay “Hospital daily allowance” for each child from S$80 to S$110 per day, effective 1 July 2026; days of confinement before that date remain at the earlier rate.

So Felix’s current SafeStay daily allowance is S$110 per day for confinement days on or after 1 July 2026.

Isla’s SafeStay daily allowance is likewise S$110 per day for confinement days on or after 1 July 2026.

The endorsement did not change the 60-day-per-policy-year maximum or the other policy terms.

Isla also has a separate JuniorShield “Daily hospital income” benefit of S$150 per day, up to 30 days per policy year, payable only from the fourth consecutive hospitalisation day; the first three days are not payable.
